entries.label: Debug Gold Balance
candidate_routes: uai_gp_hud::RewardGold(S3DX::AIVariable) at 0x65feec: native Gold reward helper; argument/read-back contract unverified
uai_gp_hud::SpendGold(S3DX::AIVariable) at 0x637008: native Gold spend helper; bounds/read-back contract unverified
uai_gp_hud::onSetGold at 0x74ff84: formats/publishes hud.gold display/model value; not proven to set authoritative balance
uai_gp_hud::onGetGold at 0x6e8e00: shopgold/shop UI flow; not a proven generic custom Gold input route
entries.limitation: Gold override is not integrated. Needs a verified current-balance read, numeric argument semantics, sandbox gates, RewardGold/SpendGold contract, read-back and rollback. onSetGold alone appears to update display/model text; OpenKeyboard call sites found so far use nickname fields.

acceptance_rules: UI presence alone never marks a cheat implemented.
Each enabled runtime cheat requires exact-build handler mapping, parameter validation, sandbox/offline gates, state read-back, and tested recovery/rollback.
The custom Gold keypad is an interaction prototype until the in-game keyboard input/commit path is verified.
No purchase receipt, paid entitlement, cloud save, leaderboard or achievement write is permitted in the cheat adapter.

native_gold_keyboard_followup.display_callback: onSetGold at 0x74ff84 formats/publishes hud.gold display/model value; authoritative balance write unproven
native_gold_keyboard_followup.keyboard_callback: onKeyboardEnter at 0x705940 reads keyboard.key_entry and sKeyboardDirect and uses setEnvVar/UpdateSlots
native_gold_keyboard_followup.open_keyboard_target: Observed account call sites pass the nickname target, not Gold.
native_gold_keyboard_followup.next_gate: Prove actual input launch context, current Gold balance read and RewardGold/SpendGold semantics; add read-back and rollback before building a game package.
